messages:
rahul: Brightline follow-up — they raised a specific ask: show proof that svc-inference did NOT have kms:Decrypt during the 90-day window and provide chain-of-custody for exported logs. Can we assemble quick evidence set?

maya: Short list: 1) rolebinding + role yaml diff; 2) CloudTrail KMS events filtered for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey; 3) Splunk export CSV; 4) signed evidence manifest + sha256.

liz: I'll add reviewer list from PR and the helm chart diff that changed the service-account.

kevin: CloudTrail example query I used:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ef12-3456 --start-time 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-03-31T23:59:59Z > kms-events.json
```
Filter for eventName=Decrypt or GenerateDataKey. I will sanitize ARNs before export.

sophie: Note: there was an ops fallback on 2024-02-05 at 23:10 where ops-service ran a retry job. We already flagged that in the incident timeline and confirmed the retry used cached data only. Need to include that timeline entry and an affirmation from oncall that no key grants were issued.

rahul: Good. Can we produce a signed attestation from IR and include GPG fingerprint?

ir-oncall: Yes — I will produce manifest.txt containing file list + sha256 sums and sign it with our IR key. Example manifest line: 
2b6f8c3a...  kms-events.json
Then: gpg --sign --armor manifest.txt -> manifest.txt.asc. I'll include key fingerprint 0xC1D2E3F4.

maya: For SIEM the Splunk query I propose:
```splunk
index=aws_cloudaudit sourcetype=aws:kms (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) key_id=\"ef12-3456\" | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
```
We export last 90d to csv.

kevin: Also run an allowlist cross-check: confirm that role inference-worker policies do not include kms:Decrypt. I ran static check against our policy repo. Output: inference-worker.json contains only kms:Encrypt for envelope use.

liz: I'll attach the policy snippet and PR #5179. Also note the RBAC change was a namespace reassignment; no new role permissions were created.

sophie: Pen-test item: stale token exchange vulnerability was fixed 2024-02-20 (PR #5222). We've got re-test logs from security QA on 2024-03-05 showing no exploit path. Attach triage doc and re-test pass.

sec-bot: Static scan: PR 5179 -> no kms:Decrypt. Evidence bundle queued at s3://evidence-prod/brightline/4887659999-bundle.tar.gz (pre-signed URL). Manifest sha256: c3d4...a9ef.

rahul: Before we handover, add a short cover note that clarifies our key-grant model: default deny to compute roles; explicit decrypt only to ops-key-rotation and HSM-gateway; any temporary use is logged and requires a CreateGrant with constraints.

maya: I'll draft the cover note. Keep it 3 bullets and a contacts section (IR, SecEng, and Ops oncall).

kevin: One more technical artifact: include the KMS key policy snippet (obfuscated) showing the AllowOpsRotate Sid and the principal arn masked. Example:
```json
{\"Sid\":\"AllowOpsRotate\",\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/ops-key-rotation\"},\"Action\":[\"kms:CreateGrant\",\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"]}
```

ir-oncall: Bundle prepared and signed. Uploaded to S3 with 7-day expiry. I added GPG sig and a timestamped attestation: \"No manual key grants were performed by human operators for svc-inference during the requested window\" — attested by ir-oncall (sig).

rahul: Great. @liz @kevin @maya please confirm you uploaded the policy and SIEM CSV and I'll share the pre-signed link.

liz: Confirmed: policy-snippet.pdf and PR diff uploaded.

kevin: Confirmed: kms-events.json (redacted) and splunk_export.csv uploaded.

maya: Confirmed: cover-note + contacts uploaded.

rahul: Sending link to Brightline sec now. Copy of outgoing email below. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Outgoing email archived in ticket TKT-4321; notification sent to brightline-security@brightline.com

rahul: Closing this thread. If they request additional evidence (e.g., grant tokens or KMS grant IDs) we'll pull those and append. Thanks everyone.
